sections.title: Policy Problem
paragraphs: A facility map shows what is recorded, but does not explain where limited resources could address potential service gaps. This POC compares explicit allocation assumptions before field review.

Facility availability, public activity reference points, potential service gaps, site feasibility, and actual policy effectiveness are different questions. A reference point within a radius indicates modelled access; it does not establish demand, waste generation, installation feasibility, or litter reduction.

sections.title: Decision Methodology
paragraphs: Mode A, greedy-equal-reference-coverage-v1, maximizes newly covered eligible reference entities, treating each entity equally. Mode B, policy-balanced-coverage-v1, greedily maximizes weighted category coverage gains. The original mode remains available separately.

Versioned defaults are analytical assumptions, not official policy coefficients. Adjustable weights and sensitivity analysis expose how those assumptions change candidate ordering. Unavailable categories stay visible and contribute no fabricated points.

sections.title: Scenario Comparison
paragraphs: This is a recorded source scenario, not a live calculation. It compares equal-category weights with the policy-priority defaults inside Mode B; it does not compare Mode A against Mode B.

Conditions: citywide analysis, 300-metre radius, 10 assumed additions, 0 m minimum distance from existing bins, transport anchors, and no cost or budget constraint. The eligible snapshot contains 3,557 reference entities and 3,468 candidates.

Both configurations newly cover 125 references, yet bus-1210 moves from rank 7 to rank 3. Under defaults, increments are 13/42 vendor references, 12/47 markets, 6/73 MRT references, and 94/3,395 bus references. In the recorded 11-scenario sensitivity set (including available-category weights individually ±25%), bus-1210 ranks 3–7 and is selected in all 11. This demonstrates sensitivity to these priorities, not general robustness or better policy outcomes. Scores under different weight configurations are not directly comparable effectiveness measures.

sections.title: Decision Methodology
paragraphs: civic-investigation-priority-v1 compares the most recent three verified complete months with the immediately preceding three verified complete months. Periods must be equal-length, contiguous, adjacent and nonoverlapping; incomplete or missing months cannot be substituted silently.

Recent and previous counts sum disjoint selected official-item cells. Increase = recent − previous; growth = increase / previous × 100 only when previous > 0. Active months count positive recent monthly observations. These configurable analytical screening rules are not government-approved severity thresholds or a public-health risk score.

sections.title: Data Protection and Responsible Use
paragraphs: Decision analysis uses fixed monthly/district/official-item aggregates. Decision outputs contain no exact complaint coordinates; briefing exports contain no case IDs or original addresses. Counts 1–4 are suppressed, with complementary suppression of the largest otherwise publishable cell in an affected month. Sparse months without a count of at least five are fully withheld, including zeros.

Any selected suppressed cell propagates unavailable counts, rates, changes and priorities; it is never converted to zero. Export validation rejects unexpected record-level fields. CSV quoting and formula-prefix guards protect briefing exports from formula injection.

Five is an analytical disclosure threshold, not an unconditional privacy guarantee. Public-source linkage and cross-release differencing remain limitations. This case presents existing safeguards; no separate raw-data privacy inventory or history rewriting was undertaken.

An infrastructure map shows where facilities were recorded. It does not establish current equipment condition, pumping capacity, operational readiness, drainage-service relationships, emergency deployment availability, present flood risk or future inundation depth.

Contracted heavy-rain machinery: 73 rows, 73 admitted, 0 excluded; 2026 edition only, published 2026-07-21. Sedimentation basins: 67 rows, 67 admitted, 0 excluded; published 2024-12-18. These are inventory records, not measured service capacity.

Official flood-prone reference geography: 9 KML polygons, 9 admitted, 0 excluded; published 2025-06-03. Four refer to Beitou and five to Shilin. This is partial published reference geography: no polygon in another district does not establish that the district cannot flood.

Historical inundation: 739 source placemarks, 695 admitted observations, 44 excluded placemarks; published 2026-09-30. Validated observation dates span 1991-06-19 to 2025-10-19. Catalogue coverage states 2015-05-01 to 2026-09-11, while the embedded KML name contains 1140307. These inconsistencies remain visible; publication dates and filenames do not replace observation dates. Counts are recorded observations, not independent storms or unique flood events.

All 73 machinery records lack an interpretable individual record date; annual resource publication does not fill that gap or establish current availability. Pumping establishment age is not maintenance evidence. Basin catchment-area units remain unresolved: area is excluded from scoring and never interpreted as detention storage volume.

sections.title: Data Governance and GIS Engineering
paragraphs: Source contracts retain dataset/resource identities, original source-byte SHA256, publication dates, retrieval and processing timestamps, selected resource editions, eligibility and exclusion reasons. Immutable source bytes support reproducible offline rebuilding. Failed acquisition, invalid hashes, edition mixes or malformed schemas preserve the last-known-good manifest and snapshot; the browser consumes one cohesive snapshot.

KML Polygon/MultiPolygon parsing validates WGS84 coordinates, closed geometry, bounds and self intersections. Pumping and basin coordinates use the documented TWD97-TM2 / EPSG:3826 conversion. Polygon holes and touching, overlapping or contained multipart components are excluded conservatively; duplicate geometry identity ignores ring starting point and orientation. Historical dates and source-reported district labels are validated. Bounds checks are not independent district-boundary verification.

A nearby pumping station does not prove a drainage-service relationship. District × infrastructure category is the review unit because authoritative service relationships are unavailable. Missing operational evidence means a question to verify, not equipment failure. Historical flooded locations do not become future hazard polygons. Unsupported/excluded records and their reasons remain auditable.

Principal drainage catchment KML was inspected but excluded from service linkage: multi-station names and missing stable cross-file identifiers did not establish a verified pumping-service model. Historical rainfall was not acquired or integrated. No proximity join, rainfall attribution or certified flood model is claimed.

sections.title: Decision Methodology
paragraphs: heavy-rain-preparedness-review-v1, configuration 1.0.0, considers 12 administrative districts × 3 categories (pumping, machinery, basin): 36 possible candidates before filters and evidence eligibility. These are district/category combinations, not 36 high-risk districts or flood locations.

Each distinct review-question dimension counts once per candidate. Duplicate fields and rows cannot inflate it; unavailable essential infrastructure collapses downstream missing fields into one source_failure. Questions are documentary dimensions, not statistically independent predictors or an environmental risk score.

sections.title: Reproducible Real Scenario
paragraphs: Recorded source outputs: snapshot sha256-d67edc57254ee273, processed 2026-10-19T01:14:54.464Z, method heavy-rain-preparedness-review-v1, configuration 1.0.0. Shared evidence scope: evidence review mode, strict evidence requirements, all 12 districts, all three infrastructure categories, include unknown/stale publication-age sources with visible review questions, 730-day stale threshold, capacity 5.

Both strategies select 北投區:machinery and 士林區:machinery. Evidence Gaps First concentrates five tasks in two districts; Balanced Geographic Review takes one candidate per district per round and spreads five tasks across five districts. Ordered candidate IDs below are preserved exactly from the source.

Fifteen versus twelve candidate-level evidence questions does not mean greater flood risk, better preparedness, more independently verified deficiencies or better policy performance. The same source-wide question can recur across district/category candidates. These are recorded outputs, not live calculations or policy outcomes.

Sensitivity reproduced from the pinned snapshot and pure decision functions: with the same evidence scope, gaps capacity 10 selects 10 tasks across 6 districts, 26 questions (6 A / 4 B); balanced capacity 10 covers 10 districts, 30 questions (2 A / 8 B). Capacity changes selections, not candidate tiers.

Strict versus permissive evidence and flood-context versus general evidence modes have different evidence-scope keys. On this pinned snapshot, capacity-5 gaps and balanced shortlists and question totals stay unchanged across those modes; all 36 candidates remain eligible. That numerical stability does not make the scopes interchangeable: permissive rules can admit limited evidence and flood mode requires eligible flood context. Changes in source eligibility or geography must not be attributed to selection strategy alone.

sections.title: Review Briefings and Data Protection
paragraphs: JSON/CSV briefings retain selected and excluded candidate explanations, snapshot/source versions, capacity, evidence-scope assumptions, limitations and agency verification questions. Exports use explicit aggregate/source allowlists and omit facility names, responsible-officer names, phone numbers and contractor contacts.

Historical output aggregates source-reported district/date observations; household-scale historical geometry, addresses, depth and area values are not republished or scored. CSV quotes cells and guards formula-leading/control-prefixed values. These safeguards support documentary review; they do not establish operational readiness.

sections.title: Important Limitations and Responsible Use

The model does not measure drainage capacity, establish current machinery or pumping availability, assess actual infrastructure readiness or certify protection against inundation. Candidate priorities describe evidence-review needs, not emergency risk. Missing operating-status evidence does not establish asset failure.

sections.title: Legal, Safety and Interpretation Limits
paragraphs: Independent personal engineering POC, not an official government-endorsed decision system. Older buildings are not automatically unsafe, and building age alone is not a structural-safety assessment. No property-level structural or hazard score, demolition recommendation or dangerous-address ranking is produced.

Renewal-unit designation approval does not establish business-plan or rights-transformation approval, permit issuance, commencement, completion, current legal status or owner consent. Proceedings metadata does not establish current government case status. Missing public follow-up does not prove inactivity.

Use permits are flows, not standing building stock. Citywide building-age statistics were not allocated to districts. Administrative record counts do not establish redevelopment demand, legal eligibility, feasibility, investment value or resident benefit. Urban renewal and accelerated dangerous/old-building reconstruction are separate legal processes; historical regulation references do not determine present validity or individual eligibility.

sections.title: Policy Problem
paragraphs: Street trees, pedestrian facilities and urban greening records are spread across official datasets. A tree map does not establish measured sidewalk shade, physically available planting sites, pedestrian thermal discomfort, spatial comparability or which observations warrant field verification.

sections.title: GIS Engineering: From Valid Geometry to Auditable Relationships
paragraphs: Analysis uses TWD97 / TM2 EPSG:3826 projected metres (easting, northing). WGS84 conversion serves map display and administrative checks; latitude/longitude degrees cannot be used directly as metre distances. A conservative projected envelope is followed by official district-boundary checks, so envelope membership alone does not establish city membership.

Closed rings, positive area, self-intersections, holes and MultiPolygon parts are validated. District consistency checks sidewalk vertices; unresolved boundary crossing/touching is excluded. Stable sidewalk identity combines the official ID with the first 12 SHA256 hex characters of canonical projected geometry. Canonicalization ignores ring starting point/direction and part ordering while retaining holes and distinct features.

A 100-metre bounding-box grid narrows candidate checks instead of comparing every tree with every polygon. Exact checks prefer unique strict containment. Without containment, a unique bounded-proximity association may use the default frozen 2 m tolerance. Multiple containing/nearby polygons and boundary hits stay ambiguous; no arbitrary opposite-road-side assignment occurs.

Pit representatives alone are insufficient: the full pit polygon must pass containment, including sidewalk holes. Unique tree/pit assignments count each observation once; ambiguous appearances retain review relationships but are non-additive. No geometry simplification changes analytical relationships, no street network is inferred, and map navigation vertices are not imagined planting coordinates.

Geometry and population exclusions remain separate: sidewalk exclusions are 4 invalid geometries, 2 canonical duplicate geometries and 151 district mismatches. Tree exclusions are 22 repeated-coordinate accounting exclusions, 455 district mismatches and 21 outside/boundary observations; these do not prove duplicate physical trees. Of 50,904 classified pits, 174 district mismatches leave 50,730 admitted. The 5,816 flowerbeds are excluded by population, not invalid geometry.

At 2 m, 89,860 admitted trees partition into 45,559 uniquely matched, 44,274 unmatched and 27 ambiguous; 3,729 unique matches use bounded proximity. The 50,730 admitted pits partition into 46,109 uniquely matched, 480 unmatched and 4,141 ambiguous. These are administrative spatial associations, not trees proven to shade sidewalks, vacant/occupied pits, measured canopy or people protected.

Mandatory identity, district, geometry/display bounds, source and verified positive-length gates precede tier assignment. Every real feature currently fails measurement admission.

Independent material questions are matched across both dimension and causal source/problem ID using maximum bipartite matching. Several symptoms of one failure or repeated questions in one dimension cannot inflate priority. Globally missing canopy, unknown planting feasibility and generally unknown pit occupancy remain shared limitations, not priority points in every row.

Only comparable numerators and verified denominators within the same eligible units could support treeCount × 1000 / lengthM. A partial tree population divided by all-city sidewalk length is prohibited. The conditional low-recorded strategy has no implemented bottom-quartile threshold and is disabled on the real source; no lowest-25% result is published.

sections.title: Policy Problem
paragraphs: With limited traffic-engineering investigation capacity, which detector/link/source evidence gaps should be reviewed first, and which corridors can eventually support reliable historical congestion comparisons? Neihu commuting and road-management challenges motivate the question, but an accident map cannot establish congestion.

A defensible comparison needs detector identity, road link, travel direction, timestamp, sampling interval, speed/flow semantics, comparable peak/reference periods, history and study geography. Historical crash patterns, historical traffic performance and observation readiness are distinct. This POC delivers readiness and conditionally implements performance logic; it never derives congestion from crashes. Intended users are transport-data analysts and traffic-engineering research teams.

sections.title: Research Geography, Link and Direction Identity
paragraphs: The seven road-name research filters are 瑞光路 (Ruiguang), 港墘路 (Gangqian), 堤頂大道 (Tiding), 舊宗路 (Jiuzong), 民權東路 (Minquan East), 成功路 (Chenggong) and 環東大道 (Huandong). Only exactly one published DetectionLink establishes the displayed LinkID/RoadDirection: 31 devices have 31 distinct accepted static LinkIDs. The 27 multi-link devices keep null link/direction mapping. A nearby device does not establish a lane or service relationship, and even single-link identity does not validate study geography or continuity with old observations.

Official coordinates support detector points, not interpolated congestion corridors. No continuous heatmap, guessed directional arrows or authoritative park/district crosswalk is published. Quality review may investigate unverified scope; performance cannot treat it as verified.

sections.title: System Architecture
paragraphs: Offline bounded acquisition is separated from analysis. Original-byte SHA256, schemas and metadata editions are checked before detector/link/direction auditing and observation eligibility. Detector inventory can be published even when speed samples fail, while invalid sources never become operational observations.

The upstream application reads a versioned static snapshot through a cached, lazy-loaded React module and pure TypeScript scenario functions. It has no backend, database or live traffic operations feed; the browser does not call live Taipei APIs. Portfolio contains explanatory text and compact tables, not raw XML, snapshots, ETL or a second traffic dashboard.

sections.title: Two Independent Decision Objectives
paragraphs: neihu-traffic-observation-review-v1, configuration 1.0.0, keeps performance A/B/C/insufficient separate from quality urgent/review/ready. A readiness candidate serializes device, metadata version, direction and readiness; its internal morning placeholder is not an observed morning period. Performance identity additionally preserves source/resource edition, link, lane identity/class and window.

Conditional relativeSlowdown = (observedOffPeakReferenceSpeed - observedPeakSpeed) / observedOffPeakReferenceSpeed. It requires the same detector, verified link/direction, lane identity/class, compatible source/metadata editions, comparable dates, valid units/cadence and valid same-day reference greater than zero. Negative slowdown is retained. Observed off-peak reference is not free-flow speed, an official congestion index, capacity ratio or journey-time delay.

Explicit Z/UTC offset is mandatory, interpreted in Asia/Taipei. Analyst half-open windows are morning [07:00,10:00), evening [17:00,20:00), reference [10:00,16:00). They are not universal official peak definitions. Daily median peak and reference speeds require completeness; weekday means Monday–Friday, without verified holiday adjustment.

sections.title: Time-Series Integrity before Traffic Interpretation
paragraphs: completenessRatio = valid unique samples / expected samples. Expected peak/reference slots would be 10800 / intervalSeconds and 21600 / intervalSeconds only after cadence is verified. The implemented grid requires a positive integer cadence dividing an hour with aligned timestamps; another official specification needs an explicit adapter.

Received, missing, duplicate and invalid records remain separate. Duplicate timestamps invalidate the whole slot; repeated readings cannot improve completeness. Invalid or off-grid observations do not fill slots, and entirely absent days are retained for an observed identity group. No schedule is invented for devices without history.

Normalized contracts use km/h, interval vehicle counts and occupancy percent, but no retained operational source passed unit/sentinel acceptance. Zero is not universally missing; source-specific semantics must precede conversion. Negative/nonfinite counts, invalid speed, occupancy outside 0–100, invalid dates and unknown lanes are rejected. Missing samples stay null, never zero speed or zero vehicles.

Static UpdateInterval 60 is metadata refresh, not sampling cadence. B's TimeInterval=5 is uninterpreted. Acquiring the stale November 2024 source in October 2026 does not make those observations current. Expected history, downtime, outages, invalid ratios and completeness remain unknown for this edition.

sections.title: The Working Observation-Quality Review
paragraphs: Actual quality population: 58 eligible source/device reviews, comprising 27 urgent, 31 review and 0 ready. Urgent means earlier metadata/source verification for unresolved multi-link/direction evidence, not worse congestion or safety danger. Review devices are not proven congestion-free; all lack accepted history and verified study geography.

Deterministic quality ordering uses tier, descending evidence-flag count, descending available invalid ratio, ascending available completeness, stable corridor ID and candidate ID. Unknown ratios remain null; internal ordering fallbacks are not measured zeros. Flags are a transparent screening heuristic, not official corridor importance or a congestion score. Ready units are not selected for quality work.

sections.title: Sensitivity, Scope and Objective Boundaries
paragraphs: Capacity 5 versus 10 compares one quality population and preserves the first five selected IDs. Fixed-scope strategy comparisons retain editions, accepted dates, devices, link/direction/lane identities, windows, population, completeness, slowdown and reference definitions. Quality versus performance additionally changes objective and cannot be compared as a congestion outcome.

90% completeness, 30% slowdown, morning/evening and balanced/repeated-slowdown behaviors are exercised with synthetic test history only. The actual production population cannot produce measured sensitivity outcomes without accepted history. Changing sources, dates, devices, windows or thresholds changes evidence scope; selecting an excluded source cannot grant performance eligibility.

sections.title: Publication Safeguards and Reproducibility
paragraphs: The six retained originals preserve acquisition endpoints, byte lengths, SHA256 and editions. Hash/schema/resource-version validation precedes last-known-good publication. The bounded fetch caps each body at 4 MiB, uses a 20-second timeout and at most one bounded Retry-After retry; acquisition is not recurring collection or an authenticated historical archive.

Snapshot ID neihu-readiness-49f28aaa55758ffe is distinct from normalized full SHA256 e54b852d17388683eddc16b46c930178451df4af78a4802663eaef579ccf3441. Upstream two retained-input rebuilds produced that same hash. Generated time derives from retained acquisition, not browser time. Portfolio independently checked the existing readiness selections with pinned pure functions offline; it did not rerun upstream ETL, historical traffic aggregation or the full source test suite, and generated no speed observations.

Runtime validation checks schema/method/configuration and source hashes, rejects nested synthetic publication markers, and forbids performance eligibility in nonhistorical modes. Typed payloads alone do not prove authentic measurements. JSON/CSV retain provenance, null period, scope, assumptions, selections/exclusions and limits; CSV quotes cells and neutralizes formula prefixes including whitespace/control characters.

sections.title: Runtime Measurements and Their Limits
paragraphs: Upstream local measurements: snapshot 120,789 bytes, source-health 4,137 bytes, quality report 4,888 bytes, lazy congestion JavaScript about 17.49 kB gzip. These are recorded development-environment measurements, not public-internet, physical-mobile or production latency guarantees. Offline preparation, cached static data, lazy loading and small pure scenarios explain the architecture; Portfolio does not rerun calculations or benchmark the source at runtime.

sections.title: Responsible Traffic Interpretation
paragraphs: Independent engineering POC, not an official traffic-control or intervention system. It did not measure Neihu's worst bottlenecks, produce real historical slowdown grades, infer journey time, estimate travel-time savings or demonstrate traffic improvement. Crash concentration does not establish congestion, and no causal accident/congestion relationship is asserted.

All 58 research geographic scopes remain unverified; named-road matches are not validated technology-park coverage. No accepted operational history, travel-time pairing, units, sampling cadence, holiday calendar or comparable baseline was established. Missing history is unknown, not absence of congestion; quality urgency is not traffic severity or safety danger.

Conditional performance examples are synthetic tests, not Taipei measurements. No fake speed heatmap, interpolated congested segment, official Level of Service grade or unresolved device-to-lane arrow is published. Official policy claims have different populations and are not POC performance outcomes.

sections.title: Entity Resolution: Main Routes, Subsidiaries and Operators
paragraphs: The 800 Route rows resolve to 416 distinct main-route IDs, 731 subsidiary PathAttributeId values and 773 distinct main-route/variant/operator associations. The 27 repeated association rows are not automatically invalid variants. Operator IDs are retained as arrays rather than duplicating investigation candidates.

Source namespace + main route + subsidiary + stop-derived direction form the original composite candidate ID, such as pto:10419:104190:0. Display route names are labels, not join keys. Stop.routeId resolves to the main route, while PathDetail.pathAttributeId resolves to the subsidiary; nearby geometry or similar names cannot repair ambiguous identity.

sections.title: Stop Posts, Physical Locations and Ordered Occurrences
paragraphs: All 28,826 Stop.routeId references resolve to main-route identities; no PathDetail.stopId or Stop.stopLocationId references remain unresolved. A route-specific stop post is not a unique physical location: 28,826 posts and 5,376 locations describe different units.

PathDetail occurrence IDs and StopSequence preserve repeated visits on circular routes. PathDetail.Type is not direction; Stop.goBack supplies outbound/return, with unknown left explicit. Sequence checks compare adjacent values within a verified subsidiary/direction without assuming each directional split starts at 1.

The 212 unresolved subsidiary references in PathDetail are retained as quality exceptions and excluded from verified candidate inventory. Successful stop/location joins do not erase those exceptions or justify invented route-stop relationships.

sections.title: Network Geometry and Geographic Boundaries
paragraphs: The normalized inventory has 1,241 subsidiary/direction candidates, with 216 exact main-route + subsidiary + direction geometry matches. Main-route shapes are retained separately; they are not substituted for an exact subsidiary shape. Valid WGS84 LINESTRING coordinates support route display without manufacturing missing geometry.

The PTO network includes cross-border records. Network scope does not establish Taipei-only district coverage, pedestrian catchments, population access or district diversity. Shape row utime can be years older than feed retrieval; row-level geometry freshness remains unverified. No stop-proximity or route-overlap measure becomes accessibility, inefficiency or equity.

sections.title: Published Service and Service-Day Time Semantics
paragraphs: Raw timetable strings and headway fields are retained. Time parsing accepts HH:mm or HHmm through 47:59; an end clock before its start rolls into the next service day in Asia/Taipei. This is interpretation of a published window, not an observed departure or arrival.

Only unambiguous positive headways or explicit ordered ranges such as 10～15分 are parsed. Compact 0510, inverted ranges and natural-language descriptions remain unresolved; LongHeadway and LowHeadway are not silently swapped. Published dispatch/headway documentation is not actual achieved frequency or passenger waiting time.

sections.title: Calendars and Unresolved Direction Applicability
paragraphs: Native DateType 0 accepts weekday 1=Sunday through 7=Saturday; DateType 1 accepts valid YYYYMMDD special dates. Unsupported encodings and impossible dates remain unresolved. A valid date is not verification of holiday or service-exception applicability.

Timetables join subsidiaries but lack accepted directional assignment. Raw schedules remain inspectable and are not copied to both directions. Main-route first/last text stays main-route metadata rather than being duplicated across subsidiaries. Special preplanned schedules remain plans, not executed trips.

No issue-count weighting, numerical shortage score or Neihu speed/completeness threshold is reused.

Evidence Gaps First orders eligible units by A/B/C then stable ASCII composite ID. Balanced Main-route Review groups that ordering by verified main route, orders groups by their best candidate and takes one per route per round. It may take another route's lower-tier candidate before revisiting a route; that is research representation, not an expected-benefit estimate.

Actual quality tiers are A=163, B=927, C=151. Capacity counts investigations, not trips or route budgets. Strict mode requires usable source references, complete identity and network scope; broader inclusion permits ambiguity investigation without verifying the join or enabling directional/historical service analysis.

Historical analysis requires eleven explicit gates: legal official access, verified identity, actual event semantics, timezone, service day, stable crosswalk, comparable windows, duplicate handling, expected/observed completeness, exceptions/holidays and outage handling. Estimated arrivals, GPS positions and published plans are not completed service events.

The separately typed historical engine can examine actual arrival/departure intervals only after every gate passes, preserving candidate/stop/service-day/semantics groups and rejecting conflicting event identities. It does not infer missed trips, executed-trip totals or reliability scores. All-gates-passed fixtures are synthetic tests, not production evidence.

sections.title: Policy Problem and Decision Scope
paragraphs: Which source records should a municipal team investigate first when its review capacity is limited and published Wi-Fi locations do not establish actual service? This project makes the evidence, assumptions and selected investigation identities explicit before comparing scenarios.

Published infrastructure, experimental geometric proximity, actual service accessibility and measured digital inclusion are four separate questions. The intended users are municipal data stewards, civic-data engineers and public-facility researchers; neither mode authorizes equipment placement.

sections.title: Official Boundary Transformation and GIS Validation
paragraphs: The retained ZIP contains matching SHP/SHX/DBF/PRJ/CPG components. PRJ TWD_1997_TM_Taiwan matches EPSG:3826 (GRS80, central meridian 121°, scale 0.9999, false easting 250,000m). PROJ 9.5.1 through pyproj 3.7.2 uses always_xy=True and allow_ballpark=False to emit EPSG:4326 longitude/latitude, preserving multipolygons and interior rings.

All 12 districts pass component/index/attribute, finite-coordinate, closed-ring, topology, axis and round-trip checks; no repair or rejected district. Maximum round-trip error is 0.000074m. Eleven original overlap pairs remain, largest 0.407474m², below the explicit 1m² admission tolerance. The analytic [250000,0] → [121,0] control checks the projection definition, not surveyed facility position. Stated operation accuracy of about 1m does not establish original coordinate accuracy.

sections.title: Point-in-Polygon and Boundary Uncertainty
paragraphs: Attribution uses original projected polygons. A 0.001m numerical shared-edge tolerance is separate from 10/25/50m research flags. Unique membership beyond 10m is interior; nearer unique membership is boundary-adjacent; exterior, multi-match and invalid results are distinct. Strict H excludes boundary-adjacent records; flagged H retains qualified unique members with warnings.

A has 3,234 interior, 59 boundary-adjacent and 12 exterior rows, 64 source/polygon district disagreements, 200 duplicate-coordinate groups and no repeated SITE_ID. Pre-strict admission is 3,229 rows. Duplicate coordinates have one distance effect, not evidence of extra installations. All 91 facilities are polygon interiors under their hypotheses, yet four fail the district/identity evidence contract.

sections.title: Facility Coordinate Contracts and Evidence Levels
paragraphs: Verified requires authoritative CRS evidence, valid transformation, qualified identity and geometry. No facility meets it. Assumption-tested admits B69/C9/D9 under explicit hypotheses and district agreement; Unresolved retains B1/D3 outside the model. No independently surveyed numeric positional control or authoritative facility datum declaration was established.

B/D 經度/緯度 are hypothesized EPSG:4326; their district is parsed from the published address, not an independent district field. C 座標X/座標Y are hypothesized EPSG:3826 and transformed. All nine C records pass district checks; alternative EPSG:3825 lands outside Taipei and EPSG:3828 has no accepted non-ballpark offline operation. This tests hypotheses; it does not prove the publisher intended the selected datum.

sections.title: Facility Identity, Exclusions and Admission Limits
paragraphs: Keys combine source ID, edition SHA prefix and SHA-256 of the name/address composite. C 編號 is a retained row label, not a stable publisher identity. No duplicate composites, conflicting composite coordinates, shared addresses, cross-source shared addresses, publisher row collisions or facility duplicate-coordinate groups were found. No fuzzy or longitudinal physical-site identity is established.

士林分館 lacks an explicit district token in its published address. 中山運動中心, 南港運動中心 and 中正運動中心 fall in 大同區, 信義區 and 大安區 respectively under the tested coordinates, contradicting their source addresses. All four are excluded without silently correcting coordinates. Closed facilities appearing in the retained library edition also demonstrate why admission never proves current operation.

sections.title: Mode B Candidate Grain and Geometric Proximity
paragraphs: H is the qualified published hotspot-coordinate reference set; R and C are the same 87 admitted facility-record composites in the combined assumed cohort. Records, distinct coordinates, reference identities, hypothetical investigation candidates and actual access points are different units. Verified-only has R=C=0 and excludes all 91 audited facility rows.

Offline Haversine distances use mean Earth radius 6,371,008.8m and inclusive research thresholds 100/250/500m. Nearest-H and facility-neighbor associations are precomputed; React filters small lists. Baseline is min distance(R,H) ≤ radius. Each newly associated reference is counted once, excluding baseline and previously counted members. None of these distances measures wireless signal reach.

sections.title: Self-Reference Safeguards and the Negative Result

Combined baselines are 69/85/87 of 87 at 100/250/500m. Capacity 5 and 10 lists add 0 references. All adds 18/2/0, exclusively guaranteed own-reference contributions. These are descriptive geometric accounting results, not an allocation improvement. No valid nontrivial geographic optimization ranking was delivered for this cohort.

The POC allocates administrative investigation slots for infrastructure data stewards, public works analysts, asset-inventory administrators, inspection documentation teams and civic engineering researchers. Nonblank bridge_id appears on 455 rows, comprising 413 distinct values: 404 rows have a unique nonblank ID, while 51 rows share 9 repeated IDs; 157 rows are blank. A source ID, an edition-bound inventory row and bridge_id serve different contracts. A blank bridge_id alone does not reject an otherwise unique research association.

sections.title: Conservative Cross-source Reconciliation
paragraphs: No authoritative government A↔B crosswalk was established. Exact-name research matching normalizes full-width ASCII, whitespace and 臺/台 only; parentheses, directions, numbering and suffixes remain significant. For example 橋① is not normalized to 橋1. Names must agree with published district and compatible responsible authority; only the full municipal public-works prefix is removed as an authority alias.

Admission requires a unique compatible candidate, valid unique source ID and no disqualifying duplicate bridge_id. Multiple candidates, malformed IDs and reused inventory candidates remain ambiguous; same name with conflicting district/authority is rejected. No unrestricted fuzzy or point-distance matching is used. Name-based composites do not establish longitudinal or physical-site identity.

Finite scalar numeric pairs are screened against Taiwan119–123°E/21–26°N and the object against broad Taipei121.4–121.7°E/24.9–25.3°N; CountyCode63000 and recognized AreaCode labels are required. Reversed axes, empty strings, arrays and booleans cannot become coordinates.

Available object/endpoints are checked independently for gross contradictions: object-to-endpoint over12km or endpoint separation over15km excludes the record. Missing endpoints remain limitations without automatically rejecting a coherent object point. All612 B coordinate sets are plausible in this edition;32 non-bridge categories (28culverts/4other) leave580 inventory reference points. Under the explicit hypothesis that bridge longitude/latitude is EPSG:4326, an offline polygon check evaluates object, start and end separately; holes, disconnected parts, edges and multiple hits remain explicit.

Start/end inside counts are192/187;24 object points are within a20m boundary review band. These are supplementary flags, not automatic source corrections or new exclusions. Tier B covers other documentary questions, including missing fields, unmatched identity, unverified interval or result terminology and geographic exclusion. Tier C would be routine follow-up with no outstanding issue.

There is no weighted danger score: missingness, cost, age and dimensions do not quantify structural condition or resident risk.

Filters apply before selection;5/10/all are documentation slots, not maintenance budgets.

paragraphs: Mode B is completed for the194 A documentation records with accepted within-edition association and admitted B reference point. Its eligibility excludes222 A records; the distinct independent inventory layer has580 eligible reference rows. These cohorts are not interchangeable. Broader documentary eligibility never assigns coordinates to ambiguous or rejected records.

Official labels and plausible degrees support display, but no authoritative CRS/datum certification, projection transformation or district polygon containment was performed. boundaryValidated remains false. The object is not necessarily a bridge center, entrance or surveyed alignment; endpoints do not certify a bridge axis. Blue markers carry inspection text only after accepted linkage and screening; grey inventory markers carry no attached inspection result.

paragraphs: The geographic subset contains194 Tier B records. Capacity5 represents1 versus5 published groups and shares0IDs; capacity10 represents2 versus10 groups and shares2IDs. All194 members represent12 source groups under both strategies. These are bounded administrative research lists; neither representation nor proximity demonstrates funding fairness or safety.

The upstream map caps display at200 points, while candidate cards paginate20 and the first200 inventory points also have a20-row text equivalent. This cap is not the complete612-row source or580-point admitted inventory. The tables below use bounded first-five examples with exact source-bound IDs; the pinned results export preserves all capacity10 and all-selected lists.

sections.title: Eligibility Sensitivity and Source-Prose Discrepancies
paragraphs: Default Mode A evidence-first capacity5 admits416. Accepted-only admits216; accepted-or-ambiguous documentation admits221; accepted/geographic admits194; critical-conflicts-only admits23. Compare exact IDs and first-match exclusion counts rather than treating population changes as policy benefit. Wider documentary admission does not grant geography.

The executable source and published results take precedence over inconsistent prose: accepted-only and geographic have the same top five (r102–r106); accepted-or-ambiguous instead selects five ambiguous Tier A rows. All three identity/geography restrictions replace all five default IDs. Critical-only retains the default five IDs despite its smaller23-row population. Stable results are reported as such; no forced sensitivity difference is invented.

sections.title: Real Records and Conservative Exclusions
paragraphs: 安泰橋 (A row24, sequence23) is accepted and geographically admitted, Tier B; questions concern inspection terminology and maintenance completeness. 康樂橋 (row23, sequence22) is ambiguous and receives no inspection-linked marker. 社教館人行地下道 (row2) has no name counterpart; no inventory relationship is invented. 中正橋 (row311) lacks a published inspection year, requiring clarification rather than a definitive overdue finding.

康忠橋 (A row63) has an accepted documentary association but fails the bridge-category geography gate. 水源高架匝道C (B row1, ID45551,bridge_idD021) is inventory-only with a duplicate bridge-ID flag and no attached inspection result. 青礐橋 (B row25,ID28769) is a numerically plausible 箱涵 record intentionally excluded from the bridge map. Category exclusions do not imply neglect or unsafe condition. Exact IDs and original fields remain in pinned results.

sections.title: Year-only Inspection and Maintenance-cost Semantics
paragraphs: 最近一期檢測年度 and 最近一期維護年度 conservatively parse ROC or Gregorian years. Month/day remain null; a calendar-year difference from the fixed analysis date is not a verified interval since actual field work. B inspect_rate is months per inspection, but applicable obligations, exceptions, edition alignment and actual event dates are unverified.

The engine does not calculate definitive overdue percentages or compliance. Empty cost remains null, while only an explicit published zero becomes zero. Original text is retained alongside parsed values. Missing years, spending and published result terminology cannot determine repair urgency, closure or structural condition.

sections.title: Static Architecture, Integrity and Exports
paragraphs: Offline acquisition and strict CSV/JSON validation retain original fields before edition-bound row identities, conservative reconciliation and coordinate/category screening produce the snapshot. Deterministic browser scenarios only filter and order retained candidates. Existing React navigation, language type, Leaflet, CSV parser and source explorer contract are reused; no new dependency or production backend is introduced.

Snapshot content ID hashes the canonical payload excluding its self-reference; exact-file SHA-256 separately hashes pretty-printed bytes. Immutable file publication precedes atomic pointer rename. Module entry loads current.json and its named file; browser validates version/name, SHA-256,policyId and snapshotId, failing with retry on mismatch. PWA acquires policy assets on demand, using a network-first pointer and immutable-file cache.

JSON/CSV exports preserve source hashes, method, settings, exclusions and actual selections. CSV quoting and formula-prefix guards cover leading control/whitespace characters; complete provenance appears once in the first data row, including empty selection, avoiding quadratic metadata repetition. Source and selected scopes are bounded at10000,download size at20MB. Portfolio itself renders static authored summaries and links; it never runs this engine or fetches the policy snapshot.

sections.title: Verification, Performance and Reproducibility
paragraphs: Portfolio subsequently executed the complete unmodified pinned upstream suite:7test files/88tests passed, TypeScript production build passed, and the original publication verifier rebuilt twice with byte-identical snapshot and current pointer. Accepted A/B original bytes were rechecked. These were local immutable-snapshot/atomic-pointer publications, without a remote release or changed policy edition. Coverage includes source/atomic failure, identity collisions, year semantics, geographic gates, scenarios and CSV safety; the existing approximately891kB upstream bundle warning remains.

Recorded snapshot is1912829bytes/142453gzip; lazy policy dashboard approximately34kB minified/11.9kB gzip. A100-iteration local Node balanced benchmark is approximately0.202ms mean; all-selected JSON245553bytes andCSV107549bytes. These are upstream measurements, not independently rerun timing or public-host latency guarantees. Initial local preview had zero policy requests; first entry had four, and the historical directory/filter state was preserved.

The independent source replay retains exact commands, logs, rebuilt results and a portable verifier. Its generated benchmark report is retained separately before restoring the upstream checkout clean; policy inputs and source code are unchanged. Original desktop/mobile browser and network observations remain attributed upstream evidence. Portfolio separately verifies dependency audits, routes, responsive themes and supplementary official-polygon accounting; it does not claim a fresh upstream browser or remote deployment replay.

sections.title: Mode C Structural-safety Evidence Gate
paragraphs: Mode C remains unavailable. Missing evidence includes formal engineering inspection reports, component defects, load ratings, design capacity, deterioration history, work completion, applicable exemptions, current restrictions and actual field status. Published result strings have no independently accepted engineering terminology contract.

Administrative evidence tiers, accepted research names, plausible points, older published years and missing expenditure cannot certify safety, predict failure, establish overdue obligations or authorize repair, closure or a maintenance schedule. Geographic eligibility changes the research display cohort only.

sections.title: Future Evidence and Responsible Use
paragraphs: Seek an authoritative A↔B crosswalk, identifier scope, complete event dates, engineering terminology and report semantics before expanding inference. Surveyed geometry and official CRS/boundary contracts would support more precise geographic research; exact-name rejection may miss real correspondences but preserves traceability rather than inventing coverage.

This independent POC demonstrates ingestion governance, conservative joins, static integrity, deterministic administrative review and explicit evidence gates. It establishes neither a government partnership nor adopted inspection/maintenance decisions. New source editions require reviewed admission and versioned methods, with unchanged findings and negative results retained for reproduction.

sections.title: 政策問題
paragraphs: 在整備查核量能有限時，哪些行政區與設施類別應優先進行書面或現地核實？這是規劃與證據查核問題。

sections.title: 從原有資料探索到決策支援
paragraphs: 原有翡翠水庫水環境地圖涵蓋水庫水質、水文氣象、水庫運轉、河川水質、抽水站、沉砂池、豪雨搶修合約機具、歷史生態及相關水務資料。
已合併模組沿用既有靜態應用，新增官方來源稽核、KML 驗證、來源脈絡、版本快照、設施證據模型、歷史積淹水背景、查核層級、容量情境、地理均衡、敏感度及 JSON／CSV 簡報。水庫與生態仍屬資料探索功能，並非所有資料都進入本決策模型。

系統沒有應用後端、資料庫、即時 API 輪詢或作業整合。發布年齡以快照處理時間固定計算，不會隨瀏覽器時鐘改變排序。

sections.title: 資料治理與 GIS 工程
paragraphs: 來源契約保存資料集／資源身分、原始位元組 SHA256、發布日期、擷取及處理時間、年度版本選擇、納入資格與排除理由。不可變原始資料支援可重現的離線重建；擷取失敗、雜湊錯誤、年度混用或結構異常時保留前次有效清單與快照，瀏覽器只讀取一致的單一快照。
KML Polygon／MultiPolygon 解析檢查 WGS84 座標、封閉幾何、邊界與自交。抽水站及沉砂池依文件使用 TWD97-TM2／EPSG:3826 轉換。對多邊形孔洞及互相接觸、重疊或包含的多部件採保守排除；重複幾何判讀不受環起點或方向影響。歷史日期與來源行政區標籤亦經驗證；座標範圍檢查不等於獨立行政區界驗證。
抽水站靠近積水區不代表服務該區。因缺乏權威服務關係，採行政區 × 設施類別為查核單位。缺乏運轉證據代表待核實問題，不代表設備失效；歷史淹水位置不自動轉成未來危害多邊形。不支持或排除的紀錄及原因仍可稽核。
已檢視主要排水集水區 KML，但多站名稱及缺乏穩定跨檔識別碼，未能建立經驗證的抽水服務關係，因此未納入服務連結。歷史雨量未擷取或整合；不進行鄰近推論、降雨歸因，也不宣稱為認證淹水模型。

sections.title: 可重現的實際情境
paragraphs: 已記錄來源輸出：快照 sha256-d67edc57254ee273，處理時間 2026-10-19T01:14:54.464Z，方法 heavy-rain-preparedness-review-v1，設定 1.0.0。共同證據範圍：一般證據查核模式、嚴格證據要求、全部 12 區與三類設施、納入發布年齡未知／過舊來源但保留可見問題、過舊門檻 730 天、容量 5。
兩種策略均選取北投區:machinery 與士林區:machinery。缺口優先將五個任務集中於兩區；地理均衡每輪每區取一個候選，將五個任務分散至五區。下表候選識別碼順序完整保留來源輸出。
15 與 12 個候選層級證據問題，不代表較高淹水風險、較佳整備、更多獨立確認缺失或較佳政策成效。同一來源共同問題可能在多個行政區／類別候選重複出現。這是已記錄輸出，並非即時計算或政策成果。
以固定快照與純決策函式重現敏感度：相同證據範圍下，缺口優先容量 10 選取 10 個任務、涵蓋 6 區、26 個問題（6 A／4 B）；地理均衡容量 10 涵蓋 10 區、30 個問題（2 A／8 B）。容量改變名單，不改變候選層級。
嚴格／寬鬆證據，以及淹水背景／一般證據模式，各有不同證據範圍鍵。在此固定快照，兩種策略容量 5 的名單與問題數於上述模式皆相同，36 個候選皆符合資格。數字相同不表示範圍可互換：寬鬆規則可納入有限證據，淹水模式需要合格淹水背景。來源資格或地理範圍變動的效果，不得只歸因於選取策略。

sections.title: 查核簡報與資料保護
paragraphs: JSON／CSV 簡報保留選取及排除候選的解釋、快照／來源版本、容量、證據範圍假設、限制及機關待核實問題。匯出採明確彙總／來源欄位白名單，不含設施名稱、承辦姓名、電話或承包商聯絡資訊。
歷史輸出依來源行政區與日期彙總觀察，不重新發布或評分住戶尺度歷史幾何、地址、深度及面積。CSV 以引號處理儲存格，並防護公式起始字元及控制字元前綴。這些措施支援書面查核，不證明實際整備狀態。

sections.title: 重要限制與負責任使用
paragraphs: 此為獨立個人工程 POC，並非臺北市政府營運或背書，不是洪水警報服務或淹水預測，也未進行官方作業整備認證。
模型不量測排水容量、不證明機具或抽水設備目前可用、不判定實際設施整備狀態，也不認證免於積淹水。候選優先順序描述證據查核需求，不是緊急風險；缺乏運轉狀態證據不等於設施失效。
bullets: 行政區 × 設施類別不是個別房產、預測淹水區、已驗證抽水服務集水區、實際緊急部署位置或水文驗證服務範圍。
歷史積淹水觀察不是預測；來源日期與涵蓋期間差異仍未解決。
官方易淹水多邊形只涵蓋部分已發布地理範圍；北投／士林有資料不表示它們是全市最危險行政區。
未實作已驗證的集水區對抽水站服務模型，也不產生淹水危害機率。
不以翡翠水庫集水區降雨判定都市行政區淹水。

sections.title: 政策問題
paragraphs: 在研究量能有限時，應依有效的來源定義與可重現假設，優先查核哪些行政證據問題？既有建物存量、屋齡級距、歷史使照、更新單元核准、容積獎勵、會議紀錄與實際目前案件狀態，分屬不同母體與階段。
這些紀錄不能直接拼成單一重建流程。老舊建物不自動等於不安全；更新單元劃定核准不代表重建完成。都市更新與危老加速重建是不同法律途徑；本專案不預測哪些房產應拆除。
預期使用者為都市規劃研究人員、市政住宅政策分析人員、公開資料團隊，以及查核更新相關紀錄的行政人員。

sections.title: 從不動產探索到決策支援
paragraphs: 原有不動產儀表板探索實價登錄、住宅價格／租金指數、行政區比較、建築使照、土地使用管制、都市更新法規、社會住宅、人口／所得背景、公開行政紀錄，以及資料新鮮度與涵蓋情形。
已完成模組新增官方來源可行性稽核、統計單位調和、全市屋齡背景、行政區更新證據、版本快照、確定性研究查核優先順序、容量／替代策略情境、敏感度與證據範圍檢查，以及 JSON／CSV 簡報。既有市場與住宅資料並非全部參與排序。

sections.title: 系統架構
paragraphs: 限定範圍的 Node.js 腳本在瀏覽器外擷取及轉換證據。發布版本化靜態決策快照前，檢查身分、原始位元組 SHA256、結構、民國日期、地理及統計單位；驗證失敗保留前次有效快照。
瀏覽器讀取靜態快照，按需載入純 TypeScript 查核引擎與 React 決策模組，輸入及設定均具版本。沒有新增應用後端、資料庫依賴或官方行政 API 整合；作品集不即時擷取來源資料。

sections.title: 官方來源與統計意義
paragraphs: A — 既有建築物存量，context_only：1976–2025 共 50 筆全市年度紀錄，單位為棟。沒有經驗證的行政區屋齡分布。1976–2006 的屋齡欄位不可用，不能當成老屋零棟。2012 年屋齡分類無法與總建物數調和，明示保留差異；僅 18 個年度屋齡分布可比較。全市數字不分攤至行政區，也不作為行政區更新需求。
B — 自行劃定更新單元核准資料，在劃定範圍內為 verified_analysis：75 筆來源紀錄、75 個唯一文件識別碼、涵蓋 11 個行政區，報表月份為 2023 年 2 月至 2024 年 6 月，行政行為日期為 2023-02-01–2024-06-05。信義區沒有已驗證資料列，缺乏涵蓋不代表實際零案件。僅確認單元劃定核准，後續目前狀態未知；案件名稱比對不是權威跨階段識別碼。
C — 容積獎勵統計，context_only：2002–2025 共 24 筆全市年度紀錄。核准獎勵案件與獎勵樓地板面積（平方公尺）是不同統計單位，不是行政區案件狀態序列，也不是 B 的有效分母，不加入 B 的候選母體。
D — 既有使照彙總，context_only：2001–2026 共 8,855 筆，8,830 筆可歸屬行政區、25 筆未經有效行政區歸屬。核發是行政流量，不是現存建物存量，也未建立與 B 的權威連結。E — 審議紀錄，context_only：117 筆具日期會議紀錄；議程／紀錄中繼資料不證明核准、駁回或完工。
F — 官方進度查詢，context_only：供人工依地號／地址／道路核實，未驗證為支援批次操作的 API，也未自動擷取目前法律案件狀態。G — 法規與官方問答，context_only：支援區分都市更新與危老重建的法律背景，不判定資格或現行法效力。
G 保留版本有差異：此次檢視原始 CSV 有 37 筆日期紀錄，涵蓋 2008-07-30–2024-11-26；另外既有已產製目錄的 37 筆涵蓋 1997-07-30–2023-06-16。不得合併日期為同步有效法規清冊。保留 D／G 的原始擷取時間未知；2026-10-19T06:32:25.000Z 是本次檢視時間，不是原始取得時間。

sections.title: 資料治理與證據資格
paragraphs: 來源可行性關卡先於排序。存量與流量、全市與行政區、單元劃定與後續法律階段、資源更新與個案行為、已驗證與背景證據，以及缺漏與零值，都須區分。這是考量證據的行政查核流程，不是把無關公開紀錄混成加權分數。
verified_analysis 在已驗證身分、結構、單位、地理及期間內可供分析；context_only 供獨立背景說明；limited 僅在明示寬鬆品質下支援有界問題；unavailable 揭露必要證據不可用；excluded 保留不相容證據及原因。不可用或排除皆不創造觀察；必要身分／地理／定義／期間仍須有效。
來源脈絡保存官方資料集／資源 ID、原始位元組 SHA256、欄位順序、擷取／資源更新／處理日期、單位、涵蓋與排除原因。已稽核快照 ure-c81e4ef44e6c9868 固定分析日期 2026-10-19、處理時間 2026-10-19T06:32:25.000Z。首次發布日期獨立維持未知，不以目錄中繼資料更新或資源修改日期代替。
公開輸入僅含行政區彙總與年度全市背景，不填補缺漏期間，不以房產名稱、模糊地址或所有權推測修補跨階段識別。公開後續資料未知，不代表機關缺乏內部作業紀錄。

sections.title: 決策查核方法
paragraphs: urban-renewal-evidence-review-v1，設定 1.0.0，配置書面研究名額。單位為「行政區 × 行政查核問題」，不是建築、地號、家戶或重建專案。實際來源在 11 個有資料行政區各支援一個 designation_follow_up 問題，不為信義區建立合成候選。
五個查核維度採去重集合。重複缺漏欄位或同案多文件不產生獨立維度或驗證來源類型。已稽核母體每個候選都有 status_traceability、temporal_freshness、一個未解狀態問題及一種獨立已驗證來源（B），不受資料列數影響。
預設來源年齡門檻為 365 天。B 的資源更新日 2024-06-13 距固定分析日 2026-10-19 為 858 天；這是資源版本年齡，不是個案停滯期間。首次發布未知，目錄中繼資料更新日期另列。

sections.title: 實際情境：容量與不製造差異的比較
paragraphs: 已記錄快照 ure-c81e4ef44e6c9868；方法 urban-renewal-evidence-review-v1；設定 1.0.0；分析日期 2026-10-19。固定條件：全部行政區／類別、嚴格品質、優先門檻 C、納入來源 B、納入選擇性使照背景、缺口優先（gaps）。恰有 11 個合格問題代表 11 區，均為 A。
容量表保留來源比較器的行政區順序。容量 10 保留前五並新增五區；文山區只因該容量上限排除，不限容量時納入。兩個維度指 status_traceability 與 temporal_freshness 的聯集，不是加總候選維度次數；一種已驗證來源指 B，不是五個或十個獨立來源。
直接解讀：此順序來自證據查核比較器及穩定同分排序，不是危險建物、最老行政區、更新需求、公共安全風險、開發機會或居民利益排名。選取數是研究問題，不是建築棟數或完工專案數。
缺口優先與行政區均衡選取相同候選、順序也相同。每區只有一個同等資格問題，輪流選取不增加地理差異。來源調和策略也相同，因所有候選都有具體後續行政階段連結缺口。可信的決策支援系統應呈現不同策略何時得到相同答案，並說明原因；未證明任何策略較佳。

sections.title: 敏感度與證據範圍限制
paragraphs: 容量 5 與 10，以及缺口優先與均衡／來源調和比較，固定同一快照及候選母體；每區一個同等資格問題。本次完整排序不變，容量只改變截取位置。這是同範圍研究資源配置比較，不是政策績效。
嚴格與寬鬆品質的實際選取相同，因來源 B 已驗證。品質設定改變證據範圍定義，結果相同不能解讀為純策略效果或排序改善。移除選擇性使照背景改變簡報範圍，不改變候選排序；排除來源 B 後，沒有合格行政區問題。
只有一個已稽核來源版本，無法展示歷史版本敏感度；修改日期標籤不能製造較舊快照。來源、地理、類別、資格或背景變動須標示不同證據範圍，皆不量測實體狀況、法律權利、所有權人同意或重建可行性變化。

sections.title: 研究簡報與可重現性
paragraphs: 純函式 buildReviewCandidates、runReviewScenario 與 compareReviewScenarios 保持確定性選取。buildReviewBriefing 與 briefingToCsv 保存來源／版本脈絡、篩選、容量、策略、選取問題、理由、比較範圍、未解單位／階段差異及限制。
JSON／CSV 含可重現中繼資料；即使名單為空，CSV 仍保留中繼資料列並防護公式起始儲存格。匯出不含不必要地址、所有權人身分、專業人員姓名或推定座標。這是研究簡報，不是法律意見或工作命令。

sections.title: 法律、安全與解讀限制
paragraphs: 此為獨立個人工程 POC，不是政府官方背書的決策系統。老舊建築不自動等於不安全，屋齡本身不是結構安全評估。不產生房產層級結構／危害分數、拆除建議或危險地址排名。
更新單元劃定核准不證明事業計畫或權利變換核准、使照核發、開工、完工、目前法律狀態或所有權人同意。會議中繼資料不證明目前政府案件狀態；缺乏公開後續資訊不代表停滯。
使照是流量，不是現存建物存量；全市屋齡數字未分攤至行政區。行政紀錄數不證明更新需求、法律資格、可行性、投資價值或居民利益。都市更新與危老加速重建是不同法律程序；歷史法規參考不能判定現行效力或個別資格。

sections.title: 政策問題
paragraphs: 行道樹、人行設施與都市綠化紀錄分散於不同官方資料集。樹木地圖無法證明人行道實際遮蔭、可實際植樹位置、行人熱不適、空間可比較性，或哪些觀察需要現地核實。
樹木盤點 → 空間關聯 → 資料可比較性 → 現地調查 → 可能政策行動。此獨立工程 POC 達到空間盤點與證據整備分析，未量測遮蔭缺口或判定植樹可行性。預期使用者為現勘前查核證據的市政公開資料、GIS、人行設施及都市綠化分析人員。

sections.title: 決策整備：已驗證盤點與尚未開放的排序門檻
paragraphs: 已驗證 GIS 盤點：14,896 個圖徵
合格優先候選：0
官方 SW_LENG_ItemValue 欄位的測量定義與單位未經充分驗證。全部 lengthM 與 widthM 維持 null，measurementVerified 為 false。一般測量規範無法認證此匯出資料特定的步行長度分母；多邊形周長及面積除以寬度都不是已驗證替代值。
全部 14,896 個盤點單位均因 invalid_measurement_definition 不得進入排序。每公里標準化密度與低記錄行道樹排序仍不可用。這是刻意的證據驗證，不是演算法故障、現勘需求為零，或臺北沒有植樹機會的證明；不能只因已有排序演算法就發布誤導名單。
已完成產品仍支援來源品質檢視、GIS 調和、空間關聯、歧義查核、地理涵蓋、來源脈絡、可重現性、驗證與簡報匯出。正式排序現勘建議須等待測量與涵蓋範圍核實。

sections.title: 既有地圖中的獨立分析模組
paragraphs: 臺北清潔箱地圖既有公共設施地圖、設施探索、受保護樹木紀錄、清潔箱配置決策支援，以及來源治理／政策優先流程。樹蔭公平新增獨立 #/shade-equity 模組，整合官方行道樹、人行道與樹穴，完成投影／拓樸檢查、索引、唯一關聯、歧義處理、快照、條件規則、容量／容差比較與彙總簡報。
受保護樹木的法律子集合不替代全市行道樹名冊。樹蔭公平與案例 001 清潔箱政策刻意共用同一 taipei-bin-map 專案，但母體、方法與版本各自獨立；既有清潔箱基準、模式 A／B、監測、發布門檻及權重均保留。

sections.title: 官方來源與納入階段
paragraphs: A — 行道樹：90,358 筆原始列 → 89,860 筆 GIS 納入登錄觀察，含 EPSG:3826 座標、樹木 ID、行政區、樹種及已記錄量測。樹高／直徑單位未充分確立，不合理數值保留為品質旗標，不推算樹冠。共同 UpdDate 2026-10-19 15:14:27 是匯出更新，不證明每棵樹當日受調查；調查、資源更新、擷取與處理時間皆不同。
B — 人行道：15,053 個原始 MultiPolygon 圖徵 → 14,896 個納入盤點單位；原始官方 ID 唯一值有 14,165 個，重複 ID 可對應不同幾何。EPSG:3826 多邊形保留道路側別及行政區背景，不是人行路網路徑，未驗證 SW_LENG_ItemValue 不能當作步行長度分母。
C — 樹穴／花圃：56,720 個原始 MultiPolygon 圖徵，其中 50,904 筆明確分類為樹穴、5,816 筆為花圃。僅樹穴進入樹穴母體，最終納入 50,730 筆 GIS 樹穴觀察。有樹穴不代表空置，鄰近不證明樹木占用；未配對樹穴不是植樹機會。
D — 公園資訊：813 筆背景紀錄，依分析範圍不納入人行道關聯（0），不代表零座公園。公園面積不是樹冠面積，中心點不是實測林蔭人行路徑。E — 歷史綠化：實際下載 1981–2025 共 45 筆年度背景列，不從目錄的 1977 年起虛構資料；年度變化不解讀為已驗證移除量或砍樹歷史。
F — 實測樹冠與行人熱曝露在路段尺度不可用。未採用足以建立實測遮蔭比例、路段樹冠、行人熱曝露、街道氣溫或預測降溫的來源；缺值是未知，不是零。測站氣候資料與科普背景不足以支持分配熱曝露到人行道。
A–C 屬 limited 來源母體，支援經限定的 GIS 盤點用途，不能豁免測量資格。D／E 維持 context_only，F 為 unavailable。保留官方行政區界另有來源脈絡，僅支援包含檢查，不形成新樹木／樹穴／清潔箱母體，也不保證全市完整涵蓋。

sections.title: GIS 工程：從有效幾何到可稽核關聯
paragraphs: 分析使用 TWD97／TM2 EPSG:3826 投影公尺（東距、北距）。WGS84 轉換供地圖顯示與行政區檢查，經緯度的度數不可直接當公尺距離。保守投影包絡檢查後仍需官方區界驗證，通過包絡不等於位於市內。
檢查封閉環、正面積、自交、孔洞及 MultiPolygon 部件；人行道所有頂點須符合行政區一致性，未解跨界／觸界予以排除。穩定人行道身分由官方 ID 加上標準化投影幾何 SHA256 前 12 個十六進位字元構成。標準化不受環起點／方向或部件順序影響，仍保留孔洞與不同圖徵。
100 公尺邊界框網格縮小候選範圍，避免每棵樹與每個多邊形全面比較。精確檢查優先採唯一嚴格包含；無包含時，可在預設固定 2 m 容差內採唯一有界鄰近關聯。多個包含／鄰近候選及邊界命中保留歧義，不任意指派到道路另一側。
樹穴代表點不足以確認關聯，完整樹穴多邊形須通過包含檢查，亦須處理人行道孔洞。唯一樹木／樹穴關聯每筆只計一次；歧義出現保留待查關係，但不可相加為獨立觀察。不簡化幾何以致改變關聯、不推定街道路網，地圖導覽頂點也不是虛構植樹座標。
幾何與母體排除分開記錄：人行道排除 4 個無效幾何、2 個標準化重複幾何與 151 個行政區不符。樹木排除 22 筆重複座標保守計數、455 筆行政區不符及 21 筆外部／邊界觀察，不證明實體樹重複。50,904 筆分類樹穴中排除 174 筆行政區不符，留下 50,730 筆；5,816 筆花圃是母體排除，不是無效幾何。
2 m 下，89,860 筆納入樹木分為唯一配對 45,559、未配對 44,274、歧義 27，其中 3,729 筆唯一配對使用有界鄰近。50,730 筆納入樹穴分為唯一配對 46,109、未配對 480、歧義 4,141。這些是行政空間關聯，不是已證明遮蔭人行道的樹、空置／占用樹穴、實測樹冠或受保護人數。

sections.title: 離線 GIS 與輕量瀏覽器架構
paragraphs: Node.js 在部署前執行來源擷取、原始位元組驗證、投影／拓樸／行政區檢查、空間索引及大量關聯。經複核靜態快照保留預先計算關係；延遲載入 React／Leaflet 模組呈現中繼資料、選定行政區細節、篩選、地圖／表格盤點與情境解釋。
全市瀏覽器中繼資料不含個別路段，只列十二個行政區分塊檔名。選區後僅載入該區經驗證分塊，檢查快照／行政區身分及路段契約。已載入細節／排除數明示範圍，不誤作全市總數。原始 CSV／幾何不進入瀏覽器情境；作品集不內嵌這些資料集或 GIS 引擎。

sections.title: 條件式證據查核方法
paragraphs: shade-equity-evidence-review-v1，設定 1.0.0，查核單位為一個已納入官方人行道多邊形圖徵，不是路網邊、樹穴、提案植樹點或核准位置。身分、行政區、幾何／顯示邊界、來源及正值已驗證長度，皆為分級前必要門檻；所有實際圖徵目前未通過測量納入。
獨立重大問題以最大二分匹配，同時比對維度與原因來源／問題 ID。同一失敗多個症狀，或同維度重複問題，不能提高優先度。全域缺乏樹冠、植樹可行性未知及普遍樹穴占用未知，維持共同限制，不在每列加分。
僅在相同合格單位內，具可比較分子與已驗證分母，才可計算 treeCount × 1000 / lengthM。不得以部分樹木母體除以全市人行道長度。條件式低記錄策略未實作最低四分位門檻，且對實際來源停用，不發布最低 25% 結論。

sections.title: 已記錄實際容量結果與盤點表
paragraphs: 實際輸出採衍生快照 shade-equity-v1-8e4cfb4029d0831d、方法 shade-equity-evidence-review-v1、設定 1.0.0，產製於 2026-10-20T00:41:41.554Z；原始來源快照為 shade-source-v1-078b91443dc33e45。範圍為全部有資料行政區、固定容差 2 m、minLengthM 0、includeAmbiguous false。此記錄最小長度不同於介面預設 20 m，兩者皆為分析者設定，不是市府標準。
證據優先容量 5 從 0 個合格候選選取 0 個，容量 10 也為 0。行政區均衡容量 5 仍為 0，不代表達成公平。低記錄行道樹策略不可用；全部 14,896 個單位均因 invalid_measurement_definition 排除，其他歧義關聯理由可重疊，不可加成額外母體。
提高查核容量不能修復來源定義。零合格候選不是零樹木、零樹穴或零現勘需求。合成測試資料僅在測試中驗證非空 A／B／C 排序、容量與分布行為，不是臺北實際名單。下表分別保留原始、納入、配對與合格階段。

sections.title: 容差敏感度：不同證據範圍
paragraphs: 三次實際離線 0／2／5 m 關聯使用相同固定來源位元組。配對樹木為 41,830／45,559／47,744，歧義樹木 0／27／174；配對樹穴維持 46,109，歧義樹穴為 3,752／4,141／4,200。三者合格排序候選皆為 0。
容差改變接受的關聯，因此改變證據範圍，不只是相同候選母體上的政策策略。較大容差不表示新樹出現、樹冠／遮蔭改善、植樹更可行或更多居民受保護，亦未證明 5 m 較佳。必須另行離線重建與複核，不能只改瀏覽器舊配對的標籤。
容量／策略可比較同一證據範圍；行政區、來源／版本／母體、最小長度、歧義資格或容差變動則屬不同範圍。嚴格／寬鬆關聯及長度設定都不能重新開啟測量門檻。名單相同或名次改變，皆不證明環境效益。

sections.title: 來源保存、穩定身分與可重現性

JSON／CSV 簡報保留快照／方法／設定、來源雜湊／日期、控制項、問題、排除及不可用狀態。空名單仍保留脈絡與解釋，試算表公式型文字經跳脫。不匯出樹冠百分比、氣溫、健康等級、空置或核准植樹座標。

sections.title: 負責任使用與不支持的推論
paragraphs: 獨立工程 POC，不是臺北官方綠化決策或已完成的植樹建議系統。行道樹觀察與盤點密度不是實測樹冠或實際遮蔭覆蓋，缺樹冠資料不代表零樹冠；未建立路段行人熱曝露、都市熱島量測或已驗證樹蔭公平。
紀錄樹穴不是已驗證空位或核准植樹地點。未配對樹木不證明實體缺失，未配對樹穴不證明空置。調查時間與資源更新不同；未驗證長度及不完整／不同時期涵蓋，使標準化密度排序無法成立，實際合格名單為零。
未產生樹木移除史、降溫效益、健康風險估計、死亡預測或官方植樹核准。管線、所有權、土壤、無障礙與現地量測仍是現勘前提；空間關聯不證明占用、遮蔭、安全或生態改善。

sections.title: 政策問題
paragraphs: 交通工程調查量能有限時，哪些偵測器／路段／來源證據缺口應先查核，哪些走廊未來才能支援可靠歷史壅塞比較？內湖通勤及道路管理挑戰形成研究動機，但事故地圖不能證明壅塞。
有效比較需偵測器身分、道路連結、行車方向、時間戳、取樣間隔、速率／流量語意、可比較尖離峰期間、歷史涵蓋及研究地理。歷史事故型態、歷史交通表現及觀測就緒度是不同概念。本 POC 交付就緒度並條件式實作表現邏輯，不由事故推導壅塞。預期使用者為運輸資料分析人員及交通工程研究團隊。

Policy #4 新增 VD 稽核、來源指標與觀測區分、方向身分、候選道路盤點、新鮮度、靜態就緒度快照、時間窗型別、純表現邏輯、獨立品質查核、研究容量、範圍敏感度、匯出及延遲載入雙語頁籤。既有事故分析保留，不把事故熱點與壅塞分數混合。

paragraphs: 六個官方檔案合計 1,710,095 原始位元組，取得於 2026-10-21T01:43:12.243Z–2026-10-21T01:43:13.322Z。A — VD.xml：604 個全市靜態設備，58 個符合七條研究道路名稱，其中 31 個單一路段設備、27 個多路段設備。最終狀態 limited，供設備盤點，不是速率觀測。

C — 道路速率目錄指標與單一 GetVD.xml.gz 版本：limited。收到 612 個路段，只有無時區的 2026/10/21T09:43:03 時間戳，不是合格歷史序列；時間／單位、設備連結及可比較性未驗證。D — Section.xml：limited，818 筆路段中繼資料，未建立所有 VD LinkID 的有效對照，不以去除前綴、同路名或鄰近關係補接。

sections.title: 研究地理、路段及方向身分
paragraphs: 七個道路名稱研究篩選為瑞光路、港墘路、堤頂大道、舊宗路、民權東路、成功路及環東大道，盤點設備分別為 4、2、12、3、13、6、18 個。道路可能延伸到科技園區通勤範圍以外，全部 58 個 geographicScope 仍為 unverified。
只有官方恰好發布一個 DetectionLink，才能建立顯示 LinkID／RoadDirection：31 個設備有 31 個不同已接受靜態 LinkID；27 個多路段設備維持 null 路段／方向。設備鄰近不建立車道或服務關係，單一路段身分也不驗證研究地理或舊觀測連續性。
官方座標只支援偵測器點位，不插值為壅塞走廊。未發布連續熱圖、推測方向箭頭或權威園區／行政區對照。品質查核可調查未驗證範圍，交通表現不可當成已驗證。

sections.title: 系統架構
paragraphs: 離線有界擷取與分析分開。原始位元組 SHA256、結構與中繼資料版本先檢查，再稽核偵測器／路段／方向與觀測資格。速率未通過仍可發布設備盤點，但無效來源不轉成作業觀測。
上游經快取與延遲載入 React 模組、純 TypeScript 情境函式讀取版本化靜態快照。不需後端或資料庫，沒有即時交通作業串流，瀏覽器不呼叫臺北即時 API。作品集僅含解釋與小表格，不內嵌 XML、快照、ETL 或第二個交通儀表板。

sections.title: 兩個獨立決策目標
paragraphs: neihu-traffic-observation-review-v1，設定 1.0.0，將表現 A／B／C／證據不足與品質 urgent／review／ready 分開。就緒度候選序列化設備、設備版本、方向及 readiness；內部 morning 佔位不是已觀測早尖峰。表現身分另保存來源／資源版本、路段、車道身分／類別及時間窗。

條件式 relativeSlowdown = (observedOffPeakReferenceSpeed - observedPeakSpeed) / observedOffPeakReferenceSpeed。須為同設備、已驗證路段／方向、車道身分／類別、相容來源／設備版本、可比較日期、有效單位／頻率，以及同日大於零的有效參考。保留負相對減速值。實測離峰參考不是自由流速、官方壅塞指數、容量比或旅次延誤。
時間戳須明確 Z／UTC 偏移，以 Asia/Taipei 解讀。分析者半開時間窗為早尖峰 [07:00,10:00)、晚尖峰 [17:00,20:00)、離峰 [10:00,16:00)，不是通用官方尖峰定義。每日尖峰及參考速率中位數須通過完整性；平日指週一至五，未驗證假日調整。

sections.title: 交通解讀前的時間序列完整性
paragraphs: completenessRatio = 有效唯一樣本／預期樣本。只有驗證頻率後，尖峰／離峰預期數才可為 10800 / intervalSeconds 與 21600 / intervalSeconds。現行網格要求可整除一小時的正整數間隔及對齊時間戳；其他官方規格須明確轉接器。
收到、缺漏、重複及無效紀錄分開計數。重複時間戳使整個時槽無效，不提升完整性；無效或不對齊觀測不補足時槽。已觀測身分群保留整天缺席，不替完全無歷史設備虛構排程。
標準化契約使用 km/h、間隔車輛數及占用百分比，但保留作業來源均未通過單位／哨兵值驗證。零值不是一律缺漏，來源語意須先於轉換；負值／非有限流量、無效速率、0–100 外占用率、無效日期與未知車道均排除。缺樣本維持 null，不是零速率或零車輛。
靜態 UpdateInterval 60 是中繼資料刷新，不是觀測頻率；B 的 TimeInterval=5 不作推定。2026 年 10 月擷取 2024 年 11 月舊來源，不使舊觀測變成當期。此版本預期歷史、停機、故障、無效比率及完整率皆未知。

sections.title: 實際可用的觀測品質查核
paragraphs: 實際品質母體為 58 個合格來源／設備查核：27 個 urgent、31 個 review、0 個 ready。urgent 指多路段／方向未解、應較早核實中繼資料，不代表更壅塞或公共安全危險；review 不證明無壅塞。全部缺乏合格歷史及已驗證研究地理。
確定性品質排序依層級、證據旗標數遞減、可用無效比率遞減、可用完整率遞增、穩定走廊 ID 與候選 ID。未知比率維持 null，內部排序替代值不是實測零值。旗標是透明篩選啟發式，不是官方走廊重要性或壅塞分數；ready 不選入品質工作。

sections.title: 實際品質查核容量 5 與 10
paragraphs: 固定範圍為七條候選研究道路、58 個品質候選、相同保留版本／設備路段範圍、無合格歷史日期、預設完整率 80%／相對減速 20% 假設及品質目標，只改容量。快照 neihu-readiness-49f28aaa55758ffe 產製於 2026-10-21T01:43:13.322Z。
容量 5 依序選 VQ6WK40、VQKWL40、VRHT660、VSKTL00、V6140C0，涵蓋三條候選道路，53 個合格查核因容量未選。容量 10 保留前五，新增 V6151C0、V6171C0、VPBTD70、VQRTE00、VNUNJ20，涵蓋五條道路，48 個未選。十個均為未解路段／方向的 urgent，不是實測瓶頸。
更多名額擴大來源／設備調查涵蓋，不創造歷史交通觀測。重複減速優先與均衡表現兩種策略，在容量 5／10 皆為 0 合格、0 選取，58 個排除於該目標。空結果表示歷史不可用，不是零壅塞或已證明改善。

sections.title: 敏感度、範圍及目標邊界
paragraphs: 容量 5／10 比較同一品質母體，前五 ID 保留。同範圍策略須固定版本、合格日期、設備、路段／方向／車道身分、時間窗、母體、完整率、相對減速與參考定義。品質與表現另改變目標，不可當成壅塞成效比較。
90% 完整率、30% 相對減速、早／晚尖峰及均衡／重複減速行為，只以合成歷史測試驗證；實際發布母體無合格歷史，不能產生實測敏感度結果。來源、日期、設備、時間窗或門檻改變屬不同證據範圍；勾選遭排除來源不授予表現資格。

sections.title: 發布防護與可重現性
paragraphs: 六個保留原始檔保存端點、長度、SHA256 與版本。雜湊／結構／資源版本驗證先於前次有效發布取代。有界擷取每檔上限 4 MiB、20 秒逾時及最多一次有界 Retry-After 重試，不是週期收集或認證歷史檔案庫。

快照 ID neihu-readiness-49f28aaa55758ffe 與完整正規化 SHA256 e54b852d17388683eddc16b46c930178451df4af78a4802663eaef579ccf3441 不同。上游兩次保留輸入重建得到相同雜湊；產製時間來自取得紀錄，不採瀏覽器時間。作品集另以固定純函式離線核對既有就緒度選取，未重跑上游 ETL、歷史交通彙總或完整來源測試套件，也未產生速率觀測。
執行時驗證結構／方法／設定與來源雜湊，拒絕巢狀合成發布標記，非歷史模式禁止表現資格；型別有效本身不證明量測真實。JSON／CSV 保留脈絡、null 期間、範圍、假設、選取／排除與限制；CSV 引號處理及公式前綴防護亦含前置空白／控制字元。

sections.title: 執行效能量測與限制
paragraphs: 上游本機記錄：快照 120,789 位元組、來源健康報告 4,137 位元組、品質報告 4,888 位元組，延遲載入交通 JavaScript 約 17.49 kB gzip。10,000 次品質計算平均 0.0105 ms；一次本機正式預覽快照 HTTP 讀取／解析為 34.1 ms。
這些是開發環境量測，不是公開網路、實體手機或正式延遲保證。離線前處理、快取靜態資料、延遲載入與小型純情境說明架構；作品集不於執行時重算或測試來源效能。

sections.title: 負責任的交通解讀
paragraphs: 獨立工程 POC，不是官方交通控制或介入系統。未量測內湖最嚴重瓶頸、產生實際歷史減速等級、推估旅次時間、節省時間或證明交通改善。事故集中不建立壅塞，也不宣稱事故／壅塞因果。
58 個研究地理範圍皆未驗證，道路名稱符合不是已驗證科技園區涵蓋。未建立合格作業歷史、旅行時間配對、單位、頻率、假日曆或可比較基準。缺歷史是未知，不是無壅塞；品質急迫不等於交通嚴重度或安全危險。
條件式表現範例是合成測試，不是臺北量測。未發布假速率熱圖、插值壅塞路段、官方服務水準等級或未解設備對車道箭頭。官方政策宣稱屬不同母體，不作為本 POC 表現成果。

sections.title: 上游已記錄驗證
paragraphs: 來源交付記錄 npm ci、四個檔案共 66 項 Vitest 測試、TypeScript／Vite 與 GitHub Pages 建置、五項壅塞整合檢查、來源稽核、相同快照重建、JSON／CSV 檢視、延遲載入及桌面／行動版複核。未新增依賴。這是上游執行記錄，不是本作品集獨立重跑來源套件或接受實際壅塞估計。
上游版本記錄八項既有依賴警示：三項中度、五項高度。與邏輯測試失敗及作品集本身稽核結果不同。最終瀏覽器複核未重做完整實體裝置 PWA 生命週期，也不宣稱獨立正式驗收。
來源 PR #7 已合併，上游較早待合併敘述屬歷史。兩張已檢視截圖皆為中文本機正式預覽驗證，不是政府作業畫面或英文行動版證據。

sections.title: 政策問題
paragraphs: 當實際服務表現證據不足時，如何將官方公車路網與班表轉成可解釋、可重現的市政調查優先系統？僅計算路線或站牌數，無法證明服務足夠。
公告設施、文件服務、實際服務、旅客需求、可及性與運輸公平，是不同母體與問題。目標是配置有限調查量能，不是建議減班或投資。預期使用者為市政運輸分析人員、公開資料工程師與公車路網研究人員。

sections.title: 既有交通探索中的獨立 Policy #5
paragraphs: taipei-crash-map 起於事故探索，後加入獨立 Policy #4 內湖交通觀測就緒度。Policy #5 在同一儲存庫新增獨立大眾運輸領域、來源契約、身分模型、公告時間解析與查核引擎。
既有事故與壅塞模組維持獨立，其指標不參與公車層級；共用部署與介面不代表方法可互換。案例 006 與 007 刻意對應同一根專案。

paragraphs: 800 筆 Route 紀錄解析為 416 個不同主路線 ID、731 個附屬 PathAttributeId，以及 773 個不同主路線／附屬路線／業者關聯。27 筆重複關聯不自動等於無效附屬路線；業者 ID 保留為陣列，不複製查核候選。
來源命名空間＋主路線＋附屬路線＋由站牌取得的方向，組成原始候選 ID，例如 pto:10419:104190:0。路線名稱僅是標籤，不是連結鍵。Stop.routeId 對應主路線，PathDetail.pathAttributeId 對應附屬路線；鄰近幾何或相似名稱不能修補歧義身分。

sections.title: 站牌、實體站位與有序出現紀錄
paragraphs: 全部 28,826 筆 Stop.routeId 均對應主路線；PathDetail.stopId 與 Stop.stopLocationId 無未解參照。路線特定站牌不是唯一實體位置，28,826 個站牌與 5,376 個站位屬不同單位。
PathDetail 出現 ID 與 StopSequence 保留環狀路線重複到訪。PathDetail.Type 不是方向，Stop.goBack 提供去／返，未知維持明示。站序只在已驗證附屬路線／方向內比較相鄰值，不假設每個方向分段從 1 開始。
PathDetail 的 212 筆未解附屬路線參照保留為品質例外，排除於已驗證候選盤點。站牌／站位連結成功，不抹除這些例外，也不允許虛構路線站點關係。

sections.title: 路網幾何與地理邊界
paragraphs: 標準化盤點有 1,241 個附屬路線／方向候選，其中 216 個具精確主路線＋附屬路線＋方向幾何匹配。主路線幾何另存，不替代附屬路線精確幾何。有效 WGS84 LINESTRING 座標支援路線顯示，不製造缺漏線段。
公運處路網含跨市紀錄，路網範圍不證明臺北行政區涵蓋、人行服務圈、人口可及性或行政區多樣性。Shape 列的 utime 可能比擷取早多年，逐列幾何新鮮度仍未驗證。站點鄰近或路線重疊不轉成可及性、無效率或公平指標。

sections.title: 公告服務與服務日時間語意
paragraphs: 原始班表字串及班距欄位保留。時間解析接受 HH:mm 或 HHmm 至 47:59；結束鐘面早於開始時，依 Asia/Taipei 推至下一服務日。這是公告時間窗解讀，不是實際發車或到站。
僅解析明確正班距或明示有序範圍，例如 10～15分。緊接字串 0510、反向範圍或自然語言維持未解，LongHeadway／LowHeadway 不默默交換。公告發車／班距文件不等於實際達成頻率或旅客候車時間。

sections.title: 日曆與未解方向適用性
paragraphs: 原生 DateType 0 接受星期 1=週日至 7=週六，DateType 1 接受有效 YYYYMMDD 特殊日期。不支援編碼與不可能日期維持未解；日期有效不代表已驗證假日或服務例外適用性。
班表可連到附屬路線，但沒有合格方向指派。原始班表仍可檢視，不複製到去返兩向；主路線首末班文字維持主路線資料，不複製到各附屬路線。特殊預排班表仍是計畫，不是已執行班次。

sections.title: 三個獨立證據目標
paragraphs: 合格路網／文件調查：1,241
合格方向特定公告服務比較：0
合格歷史實際服務表現候選：0
品質查核可調查已驗證來源關係與有限公告文件。班表方向未解，亦未取得可比較已執行班次母體或漏班／可靠度分母。零合格不等於零觀察公車服務、零公車或已驗證服務不足。

sections.title: 架構與靜態證據交付
paragraphs: 有界離線擷取驗證原始位元組與結構、調和路線／站牌／站序身分，再發布不可變版本清單與路線細節索引。純 TypeScript 函式為雙語 React 儀表板提供查核選取，以及具證據 JSON／CSV 簡報。
未新增正式後端或資料庫，訪客不觸發擷取或離線連結。作品集呈現型別化敘述與小表格，不下載完整公車資料、不執行上游引擎，也不重算情境。

sections.title: 問題代碼優先規則與確定性查核
paragraphs: bus-network-service-evidence-review-v1，結構／設定 1.0.0，分類來源調查問題。第一個符合問題類別決定 A／B／C：主要身分／站點／站序先於公告服務歧義，再來是其他文件／幾何監測。不使用問題數加權、服務不足分數，亦不沿用內湖速率／完整率門檻。
缺口優先依 A／B／C，再依穩定 ASCII 複合 ID 排序。主路線均衡依已驗證主路線分組，以各組最高候選排序，再每輪各取一個；可能先取另一主路線較低層級，再回訪原路線。這是研究代表性，不是效益估計。
實際品質層級為 A=163、B=927、C=151。容量計算調查，不是班次或路線預算。嚴格模式需可用來源、完整身分與路網範圍；較廣納入只容許歧義調查，不驗證連結或開放方向／歷史服務分析。

sections.title: 實際容量與主路線代表性
paragraphs: 固定範圍：pto-bus-0b70f80504e5b952、嚴格品質資格、全部保留路線／附屬路線／方向候選與同一品質目標。容量 5 兩策略皆取 5 個，缺口優先涵蓋 2 條主路線、均衡涵蓋 5 條，3 個 ID 新增、3 個移除。容量 10 皆取 10 個，涵蓋 5 與 10 條主路線，5 個新增、5 個移除。
不限容量皆選相同 1,241 個候選集合、416 條主路線，順序可不同。新增／移除是均衡相對缺口在同母體的比較，不是新發現服務缺口。同主路線查多個高優先問題，或分散至更多主路線，是明示取捨，不證明公平或成效較佳。
有序名單表為保留版本的實際輸出：各策略第 1–5 名是容量 5 選取，第 1–10 名是容量 10 選取。原始 ID 不是合成範例。

實際 pto:10419:104190:0 為 A，含 missing-geometry、sequence-gap、undirected-schedule。pto:10432:10432:1 另含 inverted-headway，並有 missing-geometry、sequence-gap、undirected-schedule；sequence-gap 使 A 優先。兩者問題皆為核實來源身分與有序路線站點關係，不是建議減班、投資或已確認旅客服務不足。

sections.title: 敏感度也包含不變結果
paragraphs: 此保留版本的嚴格與較廣歧義納入皆產生 1,241 個品質候選。獨立檢查容量 5、10、不限，兩策略的選取在兩納入設定下相同，0 個新增、0 個移除，不製造人工效果。
納入規則仍構成不同證據範圍。這次身分資格敏感度不能替代未來來源版本、方向或班表語意變動。版本、篩選、目標或母體不同須明示範圍警語；選取不變不驗證歧義紀錄，也不代表政策效益。

sections.title: 效能與按需路線細節
paragraphs: 上游量測根清單 83,384 位元組、初始快照／索引 563,601 位元組，公車頁籤進入時初始 JSON 合計 646,985 位元組（壓縮前）。420 個參照公開檔案含 416 個延遲路線細節；初始量不是全部封存或整個應用傳輸量。
公車儀表板 JavaScript 為 16.27 kB gzip，選定路線地圖最多繪製 140 次站點出現。均衡容量 10 在本機 10,000 次平均 0.3622 ms，清單／索引／細節讀取解析為 32.8／11.2／4.4 ms。這是上游本機量測，不是公開主機或手機訪客延遲保證。

sections.title: 清單完整性、安全發布與簡報
paragraphs: 快照 pto-bus-0b70f80504e5b952、Git 合併 e01b651d66cedfb5106c263088dc99fbc5d5e3b8，以及根清單 SHA256 00c1f33198ef811a46bddc784119063b2ce3174c5dbe3224ba0b662098d02b7b 是不同物件。產製維持 2026-10-21T07:08:16.679Z，22 日確定性重建不刷新取得日期。
清單固定不可變路徑、精確位元組與 SHA256，瀏覽器先驗證位元組再解析。結構、數量、關係、官方 URL 白名單、取得日期及巢狀合成／測試標記皆檢查。校驗碼證明符合清單，不是獨立發布者簽章。原子清單發布在取得、驗證或寫入失敗時保留前次有效版本。
簡報保留來源雜湊／URL、快照、篩選、納入假設、實際候選選取／排除、比較與限制。CSV 引號與公式前綴防護包含前置空白／控制字元。不發布憑證、車輛軌跡或合成正式觀測。

sections.title: 已記錄驗證與獨立檢查
paragraphs: 上游交付記錄 7 個檔案共 99 項測試、11 項相關 GitHub Pages 公車／內湖整合檢查、根路徑與 Pages 建置、確定性輸出、桌面／行動版及實際 JSON／CSV 下載。未新增依賴，來源版本記錄兩項中度依賴警示。這是上游結果，與作品集驗證分開。
作品集獨立檢查精確 83,384 位元組清單雜湊、四個索引／報告參照及兩個路線細節，再以原始斷言及純函式核對實際容量、策略差異與嚴格／較廣相同結果。未驗證全部 416 個細節內容，未重跑上游 ETL／擷取或完整來源測試。
GitHub 中繼資料確認 PR #9 已合併，較早未合併敘述屬歷史。已檢視截圖為上游本機研究驗證：中文桌面、英文行動版、英文選定路線，不是政府作業系統或獨立驗收公開部署。

sections.title: 負責任使用與歷史證據門檻
paragraphs: 獨立工程 POC，不是政府背書或採用的運輸計畫。未證明公車服務不足、實際頻率、歷史可靠度、漏班、需求、人行可及性、有效行政區涵蓋、運輸公平、重疊無效率或減班／投資效益。班表／日曆方向與逐列幾何新鮮度仍未解。
歷史分析需十一個明確門檻：合法官方存取、已驗證身分、實際事件語意、時區、服務日、穩定對照、可比較時間窗、重複處理、預期／觀察完整性、例外／假日及遙測中斷處理。預估到站、GPS 位置與公告計畫不是完成服務事件。
獨立型別的歷史引擎只在全部通過後，依候選／站牌／服務日／語意分組檢查實際到離站間隔，拒絕衝突事件身分。不推定漏班、已執行班次總數或可靠度分數；全門檻通過範例是合成測試，不是正式證據。

sections.title: 展現的工程能力與下一步證據
paragraphs: 後端導向整合、異質結構調和、路線站牌身分、資料治理、可重現 ETL、來源契約、GIS、確定性查核、靜態延遲載入與可解釋匯出，構成完整證據研究系統，不代表正式後端、採購契約或官方政策採用。
官方來源 → 身分與站序調和 → 公告服務語意 → 證據資格 → 可重現調查情境。精度應由權威方向／日曆連結與實際服務證據支持，不把更多公告紀錄當成運輸成效。

sections.title: 政策問題與決策範圍
paragraphs: 當查核名額有限，且公開 Wi-Fi 點位不能證明實際服務時，市府團隊應先調查哪些來源紀錄？本案先揭露證據、假設與入選身分，再比較情境，避免以點位數量替代政策問題。

sections.title: 從熱點探索工具演進為證據感知決策支援
paragraphs: 既有雙語探索工具保留 3,297 筆紀錄、群聚地圖、附近搜尋、篩選及目錄。Policy #8 v1.0 另建來源擷取、版本對帳、版本綁定身分及有限名額的模式 A 證據查核，不會暗中遷移探索工具的資料版本。
Policy #8 v1.1 在同一專案加入官方界線轉換、設施座標證據分類及模式 B 實驗研究。本單一 Case 008 整合兩階段；PR #4、語系 PR #5 與地理 PR #6 均已合併，後者於 2026-10-22 合併。上游交付文件中仍稱 PR 未合併的內容屬歷史紀錄。

sections.title: 官方來源、版本與追溯
paragraphs: 保留官方來源為 A：現行 Wi-Fi CSV（2026-07-01）；B：圖書館 CSV（2026-06-10）；C：社區活動中心 ODS（2025-12-18）；D：運動中心 CSV（2026-03-02）；E：行政區 SHP 壓縮檔（2024-09-16）。B／C／D 原始筆數為 70／9／12，解讀匯出資料時不可交換 C 與 D。
有限範圍的離線擷取將原始位元組、目錄／指引證據與 SHA-256 分別保存，再產生 JSON。發布日、取得日、Git commit、來源雜湊與快照 ID 是不同識別。保留版本不是即時市政名冊，重建也不會更新來源日期。
舊版原始名冊 SHA-256 為 c230610998a33309677fa235ec11b05d047bf3c9379dc6a7683ff3645a422c15；檔名 1141218 不是權威發布日期，原始取得及發布時間未知。

sections.title: v1.0 名冊對帳與正規化
paragraphs: 舊版 3,297 與現版 3,305 筆來源紀錄，共有 3,286 組完全相同識別對、19 組僅現版及 11 組僅舊版。來源標示臺北市的筆數為 3,285 與 3,293，現版另有 12 筆標為市外。淨增八筆是發布名冊差異，不是新增八座實體基地台。
座標文字差異為 596 組，正規化後真正數值不同只有 33 組；另有 1 組類別變更、75 組其他中繼資料變更，現版模糊配對為 0。變更類型可能重疊；格式差異不等於搬遷，數值不同也應查核而非直接認定實體移動。

sections.title: 模式 A 身分、資格與查核分級
paragraphs: 3,316 個來源查核候選以來源版本雜湊、SITE_ID、HOTSPOT_ID、標準紀錄雜湊及重複次序尾碼建立身分。A 級 63 個為主要身分／證據調查，B 級 57 個為文件調查，C 級 3,196 個為例行文件追蹤；不是網路效能或居民受害評分。
嚴格／僅現版規則納入 3,293、排除 23。證據缺口優先依分級確定性排序；設施類別均衡查核交錯不同來源類別。5／10／全部是查核名額，不是設備數。固定版本 JSON／CSV 保留原始欄位與完整版本綁定 ID。

sections.title: 模式 A 名額與來源範圍敏感度
paragraphs: 名額 5 時，缺口／均衡各代表 3／5 類、2／3 個來源標示行政區，共有 1 個 ID；名額 10 時為 3／10 類、2／6 區，共有 2 個 ID。全部名額兩者均為 3,293 個成員、13 類；行政欄位分組不能證明地理公平。
嚴格僅現版、較寬僅現版、嚴格含舊版及較寬含舊版分別納入 3,293／3,305／3,304／3,316。缺口優先前五個站點縮寫均為 TPEE002338、TPEE002354、TPEE002595、TPEE002596、TPEE002597；穩定性只適用本版本與已測設定。

sections.title: 官方界線轉換與 GIS 驗證
paragraphs: 保留 ZIP 具有同檔幹的 SHP／SHX／DBF／PRJ／CPG。PRJ 的 TWD_1997_TM_Taiwan 符合 EPSG:3826（GRS80、中央經線 121°、尺度 0.9999、東向假位移 250,000 公尺）。pyproj 3.7.2／PROJ 9.5.1 使用 always_xy=True、allow_ballpark=False，輸出 EPSG:4326 經度／緯度，保留多重多邊形及內環。
12 區均通過元件／索引／屬性、有限座標、閉環、拓樸、軸序及往返檢查，未修復或排除行政區。最大往返誤差 0.000074 公尺；保留 11 組原始重疊，最大 0.407474 平方公尺，低於明訂 1 平方公尺准入容差。[250000,0] → [121,0] 是投影定義控制，不是設施實測控制點；約 1 公尺的轉換操作精度不能證明原始點位精度。

sections.title: 點位多邊形歸屬與邊界不確定性
paragraphs: 歸屬判定使用原投影多邊形。0.001 公尺的共邊數值容差與 10／25／50 公尺研究旗標分開。距界線超過 10 公尺且唯一命中為內部，較近者為鄰界；外部、多重命中及無效各自保留。嚴格 H 排除鄰界，旗標 H 納入合格的唯一命中並保留警示。
A 有 3,234 筆內部、59 筆鄰界、12 筆外部，64 筆來源／多邊形行政區不同，200 組重複座標，SITE_ID 無重複。嚴格邊界篩選前有 3,229 筆合格。重複座標只有相同距離效果，不能證明額外設備。91 筆設施雖在假設下均位於區內，仍有四筆不符行政／身分證據契約。

sections.title: 設施座標契約與證據層級
paragraphs: 「已驗證」須具權威 CRS 證據、有效轉換、合格身分及幾何；本版沒有設施達標。「假設經測試」在明示假設與行政區一致下納入 B69／C9／D9；「尚未釐清」B1／D3 保留但不進模型。未建立獨立實測數值位置控制或權威設施基準宣告。
B／D 的「經度／緯度」假設為 EPSG:4326，行政區從發布地址解析，不是獨立行政欄位。C 的「座標X／座標Y」假設為 EPSG:3826 後轉換；九筆均符合行政區。替代 EPSG:3825 轉至臺北市外，EPSG:3828 在固定離線環境無可接受的非概略操作。這是測試假設，不能證明發布者原意。

sections.title: 設施身分、排除與准入限制
paragraphs: 身分鍵結合來源 ID、版本 SHA 前綴與名稱／地址複合值 SHA-256。C 的「編號」保留為列標籤，不升格為穩定發布者身分。未發現複合鍵重複、衝突座標、同址、跨來源同址、發布列衝突或設施重複座標；未建立模糊配對、跨期或實體設施唯一性。
士林分館發布地址缺少明確行政區字樣；中山、南港、中正運動中心在假設座標下分別落於大同、信義、大安，與來源地址矛盾。四筆均排除，不暗中改正座標。保留圖書館名冊仍列已閉館設施，也說明准入不等於目前營運。

sections.title: 模式 B 候選粒度與幾何近鄰
paragraphs: H 是合格的發布熱點座標參考集合；合併假設群體的 R 與 C 均為相同的 87 個設施紀錄複合身分。紀錄、不同座標、參考身分、假設查核候選與實際基地台是不同單位。僅已驗證模式 R=C=0，91 筆受查設施全部排除。
離線 Haversine 採平均地球半徑 6,371,008.8 公尺，含端點的 100／250／500 公尺為研究門檻。預先計算最近 H 與設施鄰接，React 僅篩選小型清單。基準是 min distance(R,H) ≤ 半徑，新增參考點排除基準及先前計入者，每個只算一次；這些距離都不是無線訊號範圍。

sections.title: 自身參考防護與負面研究結果
paragraphs: 引擎分開候選自身零距離貢獻、其他新增參考點及總邊際關聯。僅自身、鄰接完全相同或全體已近鄰時停用最佳化。本版所有門檻的非自身新增關聯均為 0，optimizationAvailable 為 false。
100／250／500 公尺下，87 個參考點的基準為 69／85／87。5 與 10 名額清單新增皆 0；全部名額為 18／2／0，而且全是必然的自身貢獻。這是描述性幾何記帳，不是配置改善。本群體未產生有效的非平凡地理最佳化排序。

sections.title: 模式 A 與實驗模式 B 的實際情境表
paragraphs: 邊際參考近鄰策略逐步重算未計入鄰接；最佳化停用時以描述性字典 ID 排序。地理／設施代表策略先選使用最少的「判定行政區｜類別」群組，再依邊際與 ID。名額 5 兩者共有五個 ID、5 區／1 類；名額 10 共有五個、各增減五個，代表 5 對 10 區但仍只有 1 類。全部共有 87 個、12 區／3 類。
實例 B:82f4e1aedafd3b68:0474263c1a583f5e740291b4 為中崙分館，來源 B 版本 2026-06-10，以 EPSG:4326 假設經測試，歸屬松山區。在 100 公尺、名額 5 匯出中因描述性字典 ID 最前而入選，自身＝0、其他＝0、總計＝0；不是未滿足需求的證據。下表列完整 5／10 名額 ID，固定匯出保留全部 288 種設定的完整身分。

sections.title: 證據、群體、半徑與邊界敏感度
paragraphs: 實際矩陣有 288 種設定：2 證據模式 × 3 半徑 × 2 地理規則 × 4 群體 × 3 名額 × 2 策略。僅已驗證群體確實為空；假設圖書館／活動中心／運動中心分母為 69／9／9，不是可比的居民需求權重；合併 87、排除 4。
圖書館基準為 61／67／69，活動中心 8／9／9，運動中心 0／9／9。嚴格與旗標准入改變熱點範圍，但本版已測基準與選取不變。跨半徑穩定及邊界結果相同不能認證座標基準或未來優先序；10／25／50 公尺是研究不確定性診斷，不是來源實測精度。

sections.title: 靜態 ETL、完整性與可重現發布
paragraphs: v1.0 合併 fc3fe9340c460418b4255d04cf8a0150dbcf669b、方法 wifi-allocation-evidence-review-v1 與快照 wifi-policy-c250791e7736ed5bca2882ea 分開保留。最新來源合併 8e01a2bd8d762b51fae979d32fd477e378d1876b 提供方法 wifi-geographic-proximity-experiment-v1、schema 1.1 與地理版本 wifi-geo-da9f69f501af4d6e1d3f9122。快照 SHA-256 為 0f6a44f9df4139b060fa2b6d906380c0600e1d95aaa72cd4da03aed2926b3d8f，幾何為 de9fcacdd831d0d5c608bf3f8e5de2559c0a03cffa2014faf94bf92617899a1c。
先發布不可變版本檔，最後原子替換 manifest 指標。瀏覽器解析前核對路徑、精確位元組、SHA-256、schema、來源及版本。匯出保留設定、入選／排除身分、版本、假設與不可用指標；CSV 公式前綴防護及文字跳脫維護呈現安全。雜湊一致僅證明位元組相符，不是官方認證。

原始 v1.0 快照 SHA-256：91b28d7b375e7fb14ee42bfbe179d792c9e0ed0992f273582dd1e03e6bac8a82。語系修正後的模式 A 指標另指向 wifi-policy-e08d28277549c88787dea209（SHA-256 cd675db75af4b65220692dc59916c7e5b88920b42613d4b82c7affcb43e0dfaa），不能替代原始 v1.0 或 v1.1 地理版本。

sections.title: 實作挑戰與工程決策
paragraphs: 採已建立的 pyproj／PROJ 與 Shapely／GEOS，而非未驗證的手寫投影。幾何建構前檢查原環閉合，限制壓縮展開、路徑穿越及 ODS 重複儲存格溢位。原始重疊與矛盾座標保留可稽核，不以修復美化結果。
離線最近點／鄰接預處理避免每次畫面重算成對 GIS；模式 A、B、C 各自維持資格語意。上游重用雙語延遲 React 外殼、Leaflet 及匯出模式，未新增正式後端或 npm 套件。作品集重用既有案例渲染器，僅載入撰寫摘要。

sections.title: 測試、效能與獨立重現
paragraphs: 上游 v1.0 歷史紀錄為 23 個 Node 測試通過，快照 1,707,558 位元組／gzip 162,570，延遲政策 JS 28,424、CSS 3,511。v1.1 記錄地理測試、確定性輸出、桌面／行動雙語 QA、真實匯出及進入前零政策／GIS 載入；上游紀錄與作品集重跑明確分開。
v1.1 快照 158,672 位元組／gzip 17,567，可選幾何 437,741／140,735；獨立的 288 情境研究匯出 3,154,696／55,597。上游 100 次暖機本機執行中位數 0.0947ms、p95 0.1494ms，未含網路／裝置因素；新增延遲模式 B JS 約 32kB／gzip 11.5kB。這些不是訪客延遲或 Wi-Fi 效能。
作品集獨立核對保留產物雜湊，以原始純 TypeScript 函式重跑模式 A／B，不新增依賴。未獨立重跑投影 ETL、官方新資料擷取及完整上游測試。來源截圖經檢視，屬本機研究畫面而非公網驗收；原探索工具預覽保留於所屬專案。

sections.title: 模式 C 證據閘門與未來研究
paragraphs: 模式 C 仍不可用：欠缺目前營運、正常運作時間、實測訊號、連線品質、真實使用、可比期間、站點身分延續、人口／需求分母及數位排除成果。地理准入不能證明任何一項；不宣稱設置可行性、RF 覆蓋、服務人口或已改善數位公平。
下一步須發布者釐清 CRS、獨立實測控制點、穩定設施 ID、目前營運／公共進入證據，以及能區分非自身關聯的參考模型。幾何驗證與透明負面結果是已完成工程；投資優先序及市府採用仍未成立。

paragraphs: 當市政調查量能有限，應先查核哪些公開橋梁檢測與維護紀錄的身分衝突、文件缺漏或來源差異？可搜尋表格本身不能解決紀錄的語意、身分與證據資格。
本 POC 為基礎設施資料管理者、工務分析人員、資產清冊管理者、檢測文件團隊與公民工程研究者分配行政查核名額。發布紀錄、清冊列、研究對應、地理准入與查核優先序是不同證據單位；結構安全評估需要另一組工程證據。

sections.title: 從公共安全探索工具演進至 Policy #9
paragraphs: 既有雙語 taipei-safety-map 整理緊急應變／資源、基礎設施與歷史公共安全資料，不產生綜合安全分數。獨立橋梁透明目錄含 416 筆發布列、415 個來源內分組，原本沒有已驗證的檢測紀錄地理連結。
Policy #9 新增雙來源擷取、原始位元組治理、保守資產對帳、地理篩查、確定性證據分級、5／10／全部情境及可稽核匯出。歷史探索工具與資料版本維持分開。PR #6 已於固定來源 commit 合併；交付文件中「PR 建立受阻」的合併前文字屬歷史。

sections.title: 原始位元組、換行譜系與來源准入
paragraphs: 接受的原始位元組 SHA-256 為 A：3b6d39373759036e725412474636ea328828297902990ca319452893e05121ee；B：f9626b5f21bc392fbb3199962749d14daf73aa7840057346b648999c8cb49910。Git 中歷史 A 為 LF 正規化的 47,557 位元組表示，雜湊 ee4afe5592522651403d2d6173f59620884857b1d5129b83498b4eab0e3701fc。接受下載使用 CRLF，解析後原始欄位相同，不能據此宣稱檢測資料修訂。
